name: Libya (Federation of Arab Republics, 1972–1977)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and black with the golden Hawk of Quraish holding a scroll in the centre.
history: When Libya joined Egypt and Syria in the Federation of Arab Republics in 1972 it adopted the federation's flag, the Arab Liberation colours with the golden Hawk of Quraish; it was the only Libyan flag in 2:3 proportions. It was replaced on 19 November 1977, after Libya's break with Egypt, by the plain green flag of the Jamahiriya.
